evidence.quote: This perspective also suggests that the major question about LLM agents is not how to make them think, but rather how to make them more efficiently accumulate useful memes and make more targeted mutations.
The analogy also suggests that the key question is how to make LLM agents more efficient at accumulating useful memes and making targeted mutations.

However, although such agents are effective in some domains, it is unclear whether they will be able to solve many of the complex tasks of interest, for instance, tasks requiring grounded reasoning about the world.
